_comment: Developer field run: tools/dev/collect-macos-field-report.sh asks a developer ErgoptiPlus.app (infra/dev_source.lua) to run every Debug field check, the diagnostics collection and the AI download flows, then copies the results it wrote. Read at run time by infra/field_run.lua, which starts only in developer source mode, and by the collector through plutil. The folder is relative to the clone root; a step's deadline is in seconds and never exceeds what is left of the request's own deadline. An AI step with progress_max_seconds is a download: its deadline is the longest it may stay without progress, each window with progress grants another, and progress_max_seconds bounds it; the default request deadline covers every step at its bound, and the collector waits that long plus its own grace. A step that needs a person is reported with that verdict and its reason, never run with a stand-in. Each step's proves line says in one sentence what its pass shows; TODO.md's Mac todo repeats them for the maintainer.

steps.proves: The Karabiner lease is healthy: CLI present, lease phase, guardian ready, no lease failure, key loss or swallowed key this session; the lease answers that timed out, the free memory and the last karabiner.json write (size, time) are named.
The Ergopti-owned Karabiner runtime is still dormant, and what of it and of the stock Karabiner is installed or running.
The managed download chain works: system proxy kinds, PAC download, route lookup, TLS trust and one HEAD transfer.
The timer service, the Shortcuts tool, Homebrew and the Karabiner-Elements signature and Gatekeeper verdict behave as assumed.
What starts Ergopti or Hammerspoon at login, and whether each entry belongs to this copy.
The layout composer installs, enables and removes its check layout through the real path.
Accessibility is granted, the other privacy grants are named, and the running bundle's identifier and strict signature are the declared ones.
Every keymap event tap is enabled, the tap watchdog runs, and the run loop answers a timer within 250 ms; holds, late keys and the Lua heap are named.
The selected and enabled input sources are readable, and every installed Ergopti .keylayout and bundle Info.plist parses.
The keystats database passes SQLite's read-only quick check, every configuration file parses, the logs folder takes a write and the file watchers are owned.
The launcher resolves, its headless HTTP worker role refuses malformed arguments with EX_USAGE, and it carries one direct GET to a loopback server the check owns.
Every external host the drivers declare (GitHub and its API, Hugging Face, Ollama and its registry) answers one HEAD through the managed transport.
The host the Ollama registry redirects a model blob to is one the route inventory plans, so the daemon's pull behind a PAC takes the planned route.
Without a person: the app types a fixed sequence into its own scratch field only, the tap sees each key once, the field holds it exactly and the previous app gets the focus back.
One rebuild of the menu tree succeeds; its duration, its top-level rows and the slowest ones are named.
The Debug menu's bug-report snapshot collects completely; its codes count its warnings and errors.
The Ollama runtime installs or is reused through the AI menu's install path.
The Ollama server starts, pulls the smallest catalogue model (an installed one first) and lists it.
The MLX environment bootstraps or is reused through the backend selection path.
The MLX model download and serve path works with the smallest installed catalogue model, and the active-model file is put back.
The owned Ollama passes a strict signature check, its running server lists its models and predicts one token with an installed model; the MLX models on disk are counted.
No crash report of the last day from the driver or from macOS for the app's processes, each named with its kind; other apps' reports, memory and CPU are named.
The driver reloads on request and the field run resumes at its next step; the reload's duration, request to a ready field run, is named.
